run_consistentdepth_pipeline: run the ConsistentDepth pipeline to compute monocular depth estimation and fine-tune on a video dataset
run_extract_frames: run the extract_frames operation to extract PTS and frames from an input video file
parse_video3d_params: parse command-line arguments for video 3D processing including flow, calibration, and fine-tuning options
configure_kitti_mode: configure the parser in KITTI mode with FlowNet2-KITTI checkpoint and monodepth2 model
process_dataset_with_depth_finetuning: process a video dataset through depth estimation, optical flow computation, scale calibration, and fine-tuning
